AnswerInterruptRequest.description:
``POST /v1/runs/{runId}/interrupts/{interruptId}``: the answer, checked against the
interrupt's ``answerSchema``, and the mode the resumed turn runs in.
AnswerInterruptRequest.title: AnswerInterruptRequest

ChartPart.description: An ECharts option: data only, top-level keys on ``content.chartOptionKeys``, no functions.
ChartPart.title: ChartPart

ContentPartData.description: One content part a node produced (views), also kept in the turn's answer message.
ContentPartData.title: ContentPartData

DatasetPage.description: ``GET /v1/datasets/{datasetId}``: one page of a dataset's rows, filtered and sorted.
DatasetPage.title: DatasetPage

DatasetRef.description:
Full data of a database, HTTP or tool result, kept outside state (design 9.3). The wire
shape is the Node.js runtime's (content parts carry it); ``node_id``, ``visit`` and
``preview`` are this runtime's provenance and inline rows.
DatasetRef.title: DatasetRef

ErrorDetail.description: One validation problem: the request path and a short message; never internal details.
ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail

FormPart.description: A schema-driven form answering an interrupt (design 9.4).
FormPart.title: FormPart

HealthStatus.description:
``/healthz`` and ``/readyz``: ``ok``; ``degraded`` (ready, shedding new runs); or
``not_ready`` naming the failing dependency.
HealthStatus.title: HealthStatus

HtmlPart.description: A builder ``htmlTemplate`` view, sanitized on the server; shown in a sandboxed ``iframe``.
HtmlPart.title: HtmlPart

NodeTypeInfo.description: One node type the runtime executes, with its ports and effective output schema.
NodeTypeInfo.title: NodeTypeInfo

NodeVisitList.description: ``GET /v1/runs/{id}/nodes``: one entry per node visit, in completion order; no outputs.
NodeVisitList.title: NodeVisitList

RunAccepted.description: ``202``: the run goes on; poll ``links.self`` or follow ``links.events``.
RunAccepted.title: RunAccepted

RunCallback.description:
Where an ``async`` run's completion summary is posted (P4-05): an allow-listed URL, signed
with the HMAC key the secret reference names.
RunCallback.title: RunCallback

RunError.description: The user-safe error of a failed run: catalog code, message and retry flag.
RunError.title: RunError

RunInterrupt.description: A pending interrupt of a run (P4-02).
RunInterrupt.title: RunInterrupt

SwarmMemberData.description: A member step of a Swarm node; ``status``, ``durationMs`` and ``usage`` when it finished.
SwarmMemberData.title: SwarmMemberData

TimelineEntry.description: Compact per-visit record, saved at turn end.
TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry

Trace.description: ``GET /v1/runs/{runId}/trace``: the trace header, its observation tree and its scores.
Trace.title: Trace

TraceLink.description: ``GET /v1/runs/{runId}/trace-link``: the run's trace on the Langfuse server, when one is configured.
TraceLink.title: TraceLink

UsageList.description: ``GET /v1/observability/usage``: daily node usage, or model usage of the caller's tenant.
UsageList.title: UsageList
